hyperedges.label: Design + Discipline Pairing: impeccable (Operate mode craft) + ponytail (YAGNI ladder) jointly govern dashboard surface changes

nodes.label: Full Extraction Plan (superseded)
nodes.rationale: A locked plan to wipe all widgets and chart primitives and re-extract from the vendored shadcn-extraction tree. It describes a repo state that no longer holds - shadcn-extraction is gone and the widget set was kept, not wiped. Historical only.

nodes.label: Four Chart Wrappers
nodes.rationale: BarChart, DonutChart, MiniBarChart and ProgressRing. AreaChart, LineChart and Sparkline were deleted because nothing rendered them; the generic Chart still supports type='area' and type='line'.

nodes.label: Generic Chart Dispatcher
nodes.rationale: A project-local component appended to ui/chart.tsx. It infers the x-axis key (first string value) and series keys (remaining number values) from data[0], so every row must share a shape. Typed as ChartDatum = Record<string, string | number>.

nodes.label: Chart Palette Token Convention
nodes.rationale: Series colors come from --chart-1 through --chart-5 assigned round-robin by index; MiniBarChart defaults to --primary. Every token is rewritten at runtime by theme-scope, so hardcoded hex breaks theming.

nodes.label: No Direct Recharts in Widgets
nodes.rationale: Widgets must go through the wrappers; a new wrapper is only justified once a pattern appears three or more times.

nodes.label: Primitives Come From the shadcn CLI
nodes.rationale: Hand-writing into src/components/ui desyncs from upstream and from _registry.ts. Only 28 primitives remain - the ones the preview grid renders; anything else is re-added with npx shadcn add.
nodes.norm_label: primitives come from the shadcn cli

nodes.label: No ui Barrel
nodes.rationale: src/components/ui/index.ts was removed as unused; primitives are imported by file path.

nodes.label: Icon Placeholder Resolver
nodes.rationale: Project-local, not shadcn. Resolves a tabler icon name to a component with a rounded-square fallback, and accepts lucide/hugeicons/phosphor/remixicon props so the icon-library picker can round-trip them without leaking onto the svg. Those bindings are underscore-prefixed on purpose.

nodes.label: Bug Fix = Root Cause Not Symptom
nodes.norm_label: bug fix = root cause not symptom

nodes.label: @theme inline Token Dance
nodes.rationale: A new token needs three edits in app/globals.css: declare in :root, override in .dark, expose in @theme inline. Consume via the utility, never a raw var() in a component.

nodes.label: Base UI, Not Radix
nodes.rationale: The base-luma style builds on @base-ui/react primitives. Reaching for Radix slots is a category error in this project.

nodes.label: Vestigial tailwind.config.ts
nodes.rationale: A v3-style config file is committed but inert under Tailwind v4, which reads tokens from @theme inline in globals.css. It survives as a trap for agents adding v3 patterns.

nodes.label: globals.css Import Order
nodes.rationale: tailwindcss, then tw-animate-css, then shadcn/tailwind.css - the third resolves through node_modules/shadcn, not a tsconfig alias. Order matters; removing the third import silently changes the render.

nodes.label: Live Theme Customizer
nodes.rationale: Product identity: pick style, base color, accent, chart palette, fonts, icon library, radius and menu treatment; 42 real widgets re-skin instantly. Export as a --preset code.

nodes.label: Runtime Token Injection
nodes.rationale: use-design-system holds the config, theme-scope reads src/registry and writes CSS custom properties into a style tag scoped to .theme-scope, preview-grid renders every widget inside that scope. No reload, no rebuild.

nodes.label: tsconfig Stub Modules
nodes.rationale: src/lib holds only lucide-react.ts and stub-empty.ts, resolved through tsconfig paths to satisfy imports from vendored shadcn source. They are not application code.

nodes.label: Single /create Route
nodes.rationale: The app deliberately has exactly one page. /analytics, /login, /settings and the (dashboard) route group were deleted; / is a 307 redirect declared in next.config.ts rather than an app/page.tsx, because a root page file would shadow the redirect.

nodes.label: Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: No 'done' claim is allowed until npm run build, npm run lint, and npx tsc --noEmit all exit 0 from website/. There is no test script by design.

nodes.label: Mock-first Data Rule
nodes.rationale: Widgets consume typed fixtures only. Introducing fetch() or backend integration into an existing widget requires explicit owner approval, so the preview grid stays deterministic under theme changes.

nodes.label: Optional data Prop Contract
nodes.rationale: Every widget signs as ({ data = mockData }: { data?: FooData }) so a parent can supply real data later without breaking the standalone preview render.

nodes.label: Kebab-case Widget Folders
nodes.rationale: 41 of 42 widget folders are kebab-case; RevenueChart/ is a tracked PascalCase anomaly that must not be propagated.

nodes.label: Clean Lint Invariant
nodes.rationale: eslint.config.mjs carries exactly two overrides - an ^_ ignore pattern and a relaxation scoped to src/lib and src/registry. Widening those globs to make new code pass is forbidden.

nodes.label: Remote Image Allowlist
nodes.rationale: album-card loads its cover from images.unsplash.com, permitted via next.config.ts images.remotePatterns. A new remote host throws at runtime until it is added.

nodes.label: Calendar Hydration Mismatch
nodes.rationale: react-day-picker formats data-day differently on server and client by locale. Pre-existing, cosmetic, non-blocking - documented so agents stop trying to fix it.

nodes.label: Grid Owns Width, Card Owns Padding
nodes.rationale: Widget Card roots carry no w-full / max-w-* / mx-auto and no p-4. Width belongs to the grid cell; padding belongs to CardHeader/CardContent/CardFooter, which pad 24px. Before this rule the 41 cards measured content insets of 16px, 24px and 40px depending on which demo they were lifted from, and four cards clamped to 448px at single-column while the rest spanned 652px.
nodes.norm_label: grid owns width, card owns padding

nodes.label: Widget Folder Barrel
nodes.rationale: Every widget folder exposes index.ts re-exporting its default. widgets/index.ts must import via the folder ('./album-card'), never the file path, so the folder stays the widget's public API.

nodes.label: Two-step Widget Registration
nodes.rationale: Adding a widget takes two edits: the widgets/index.ts barrel AND preview-grid.tsx. Step one alone exports it but renders it nowhere, because there is no dashboard route left.

nodes.label: Right Primitive per Data Shape
nodes.rationale: Percentage to ProgressRing, categorical shares to DonutChart, time-series bars to BarChart, row-internal to MiniBarChart. Substituting produces charts that mislead about the data's shape.

nodes.label: No Width on Card Root
nodes.rationale: w-full, max-w-md, max-w-2xl and mx-auto on a widget Card were demo-page leftovers. Inside a grid cell max-w-* clamps that one card narrower than its neighbours at single-column and mx-auto centres it in its own cell, producing a ragged left edge. All were stripped.

nodes.label: No Padding on Card Root
nodes.rationale: A p-4 on the Card root either sits outside the 24px-padded slots (40px inset) or replaces them entirely (16px inset). Either way that card's content edge stops lining up with the rest of the grid. Padding belongs to CardHeader/CardContent/CardFooter.

nodes.label: min-w-0 Shrink Contract
nodes.rationale: Grid and flex items default to min-width:auto, so a wide child pushes its card past the column. preview-grid sets [&>*]:min-w-0 on its children; inside a card, a flexible label needs min-w-0 and its fixed control needs shrink-0, with truncate or break-words on long strings. A 1fr track is minmax(auto,1fr) - write minmax(0,1fr) for unbroken text like an email address.

nodes.label: Column Span, Not a Wider Card
nodes.rationale: A widget with a hard minimum width gets a span in preview-grid.tsx rather than a wider Card. UpcomingPayments is wrapped in md:col-span-2 [&>*]:h-full because the react-day-picker month table cannot render below ~280px; the h-full is required because the wrapper div becomes the grid item, so the Card inside no longer stretches to the row height on its own.
nodes.norm_label: column span, not a wider card
